target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory/c_suite
./collatz_tests tilt-law --octave-min 16 --seeds-per-octave 20000 --apertures 4,6,8 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "=== rows ==="; grep -vc '^#' out/tilt_law.csv
echo "=== full-excursion bulk law (segment=full), averaged ==="
awk -F, '!/^#/ && $5=="full" && $7>=64 {n++; p1+=$8;p2+=$9;p3+=$10;p4+=$11; epd+=$17; klc+=$14}
  END{ if(n){printf "events(len>=64)=%d\n p1=%.4f p2=%.4f p3=%.4f p4=%.4f  (critical p^1: .375 .1875 .0938 .0469)\n entropy_per_digit=%.4f (target H2(3/4)=0.8113)\n KL_to_p1=%.4f\n",n,p1/n,p2/n,p3/n,p4/n,epd/n,klc/n} else print "no long full excursions"}' out/tilt_law.csv
